Contradiction! Every way forward fails: going left would force the two-exit cells to link up into a loop (or put the numbers out of order); going down-left would force the two-exit cells to link up into a loop (or put the numbers out of order). So my guess (down-right from cell (2,1)) was wrong, so the line must go down-left.

The line must go up-left: left is number 34, which comes later.
Going down-left would leave both number 33 and number 34 needing the line next, and it can't do both. So the line goes left.
The line must go down-right: down-left is number 35, which comes later.
Going down-left would wall in number 35, the last number; going down-right would turn number 34 into a dead-end pocket with no way out. So the line goes right.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes down-left.
Every cell is covered and the numbers are in order. Case closed!
